paper_title: DART Distilling Autoregressive Reasoning to Silent Thought
caption: Accuracy and inference time on GSM8K with varying C, the number of ST tokens.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of ST tokens and two performance metrics. The x-axis represents the ST token number, labeled as "ST Token Number C", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 and tick labels at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis on the left side is labeled "Accuracy (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 36 to 43, while the y-axis on the right side is labeled "Inference time (ms)" with a linear scale ranging from 33 to 40. The plot contains two lines: one blue line with circle markers and solid line style representing accuracy, starting at approximately 36.5% at ST token number 0, peaking at around 42.5% at ST token number 20, and ending at about 42% at ST token number 30; and one red line with square markers and solid line style representing inference time, starting at approximately 39.2 ms at ST token number 0, and ending at about 40 ms at ST token number 30.
